raw_segments.text: Ah, by my word, there is something singular about you," said he.
"'You have the air of a little non-net, quaint, quiet, grave, and simple as you sit
with your hands before you, and your eyes generally bent on the carpet except by the
by when they are directed piercingly to my face, as just now, for instance.
And when one asks you a question, or makes a remark to which you are obliged to reply,
you wrap out a round rejoinder which, if not blunt, is at least brusque.
What do you mean by it?'"
